info.name: Transitly Secure & Encrypted API Workflows
info.description: Enterprise Postman Collection for Transitly: Intercity bus cargo logistics, distributed sagas, 2-step authentication, geofenced dispatch matching, custody PIN settlement, idempotent financial payouts, and real-time highway telematics.

item.name: 01. Authentication & Session Security
item.description: NIST SP 800-63B compliant two-step authentication, rate limiting, anti-injection sanitization, and cryptographic JWT issuance.

item.name: 01. Request 6-Digit Verification OTP
item.description: Dispatches a purpose-bound 6-digit OTP code to SMS, WhatsApp, or Email with exponential backoff.

exec: pm.test("Response contains valid OTP dispatch metadata", function () {
// In non-production, extract ephemeral testOtp for zero-touch test automation

item.name: 02. Verify OTP & Issue Encrypted Session Token
item.description: Validates 6-digit verification code using constant-time hashing, invalidates OTP (single-use), and issues signed JWT bearer token.

exec: pm.test("Token returned and matches JWT format", function () {
// Save JWT session token into encrypted environment variable
console.log("[Saved Encrypted JWT Token]: length", json.data.token.length);

item.name: 03. Register New User Identity
item.description: Direct user signup endpoint registering customer or delivery partner credentials in PostgreSQL.

item.name: 04. Inspect Authenticated Profile (Protected)
item.description: Protected route querying current verified session profile and historical shipment stats from PostgreSQL.

exec: pm.test("Profile returned with valid user structure", function () {

item.name: 05. Update Encrypted User Preferences
item.description: Updates JSONB notification preferences, biometric authentication toggles, and locale settings.

item.name: 06. List Saved Delivery Addresses
item.description: Queries PostGIS-backed saved customer pickup and dropoff locations.

item.name: 07. Add Saved Address with Coordinates

item.name: 08. List Vault Payment Methods
item.description: Retrieves tokenized card records and UPI VPAs without exposing full PANs.

item.description: Logs customer or rider issue ticket associated with active tracking ID.

item.name: 02. List Active Shipments
item.description: Queries all current active shipments for customer tracking view.

item.name: 03. Inspect Shipment & Audit Legs
item.description: Queries single shipment by tracking ID including all multi-modal legs and timestamps.

item.name: 04. Query Trunk Capacity Slots
item.description: Returns real-time available volume and weight quotas across Haryana Roadways corridors.

item.name: 05. Multi-Modal Last-Mile Feasibility
item.description: Calculates spatial radius feasibility and estimated time to pickup/deliver.

item.name: 03. Delivery Partner Cockpit & Geofenced Dispatch
item.description: Partner duty state machine, spatial dispatch matching queue, 30s TTL priority offers, and telemetry updates.

item.name: 01. Toggle Duty State Machine
item.description: Switches delivery partner state between ONLINE and OFFLINE with auto-accept preference.

item.name: 02. Rider Shift Cockpit & Dashboard
item.description: Fetches live shift duration, completed deliveries count, battery health, and next active task.

item.name: 03. Spatial Dispatch Queue Pool
item.description: Returns real-time parcel pool prioritized by proximity and payout, along with active 30s priority offer if present.

item.name: 04. Respond to 30s Priority Dispatch Offer
item.description: Accepts or declines a time-limited priority order assignment.

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200 or 409 (if expired)", function () {

item.name: 05. Update Rider GPS Telemetry Location
item.description: Broadcasts rider device latitude and longitude for live customer tracking and spatial matching.

item.name: 04. Custody Transfer & 4-Digit PIN Handoff
item.description: Cryptographic proof of delivery, PostGIS geofence proximity verification, and atomic settlement.

item.name: 01. Query Active Delivery Task
item.description: Queries active order in transit assigned to current authenticated rider.

item.name: 02. Geofenced 4-Digit PIN Verification & Settlement
item.description: Submits 4-digit PIN with rider GPS coordinates. Validates rider is within 150m geofence radius and settles payment atomically.

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200 or 400 (if simulated wrong PIN/distance)", function () {

item.name: 03. Chain-of-Custody Handoff Log
item.description: Records custody exchange between first-mile rider and bus driver at depot terminal.

item.name: 05. Financial Ledger & Idempotent Payouts
item.description: Immutable double-entry ledger queries and instant cash-outs guarded by unique Idempotency-Key headers.

item.name: 01. Fetch Rider Real-Time Ledger & Balance
item.description: Queries rider available balance, pending payouts, incentive bonuses, and weekly earnings trends.

item.name: 02. Instant Payout Request (Idempotency Guard)
item.description: Triggers instant payout via UPI / IMPS. Dynamic pre-request script injects a cryptographically unique Idempotency-Key header to prevent duplicate transfers.

exec: pm.test("Status code is 200 or 400 (if zero balance)", function () {

item.name: 06. Highway Telematics & PostGIS Routes
item.description: High-frequency bus telematics ingestion (Redis Fast Path), PostGIS spatial proximity queries, and official Haryana Roadways routes.

item.name: 01. Ingest Highway Bus Telematics Ping
item.description: Ingests sub-second vehicle GPS telemetry into memory cache with async batching to PostGIS.

item.name: 02. PostGIS Spatial Nearby Vehicle Search
item.description: Runs spatial radius query returning all active cargo-carrying buses within specified distance.

item.name: 03. Carrier Live Telematics by Plate Number
item.description: Queries latest coordinates, speed, battery, and heading for designated intercity bus.

item.name: 04. Telemetry FastPath & PostGIS Health
item.description: Monitors Redis Fast Path latency and PostGIS PostgreSQL health status.

item.name: 05. Official Haryana Roadways Corridors & Stops
item.description: Returns official route sequences, coordinates, and scheduled offset minutes across Delhi-Chandigarh, Narnaul, Sirsa, and Jaipur corridors.

exec: pm.test("Returns Haryana Roadways route inventory", function () {

item.description: Authenticates Meta webhook setup with hub.verify_token and echoes back hub.challenge.

item.description: Simulates incoming user message asking for tracking updates on highway parcel.
